newsitem.title: MEXICO: GBM Atlantico 1997 Q1 net profit vs loss.
newsitem.headline: GBM Atlantico 1997 Q1 net profit vs loss.

text.p: Mexican financial group GBM Atlantico said on Thursday that it posted net profits of 37 million pesos in the first quarter of 1997 compared to a net loss of 87 million peosos in the same period last year.
The company also said that its capitalization index as of the end of the Q1 was 12.48 percent, which is 4.48 percentage points above the required minimum.

The company said in a press release that the GBM brokerage had net profits of 18 million; the Banco del Atlantico bank unit 9.5 million pesos; and the insurance subsidiary 2.2 million pesos. There was an unspecified net loss in the controlling group.

The press release said the bank unit posted gains even after spending 172 million pesos on reserve-building and restructuring, reaching coverage against past-due loans of 50.1 percent, which is greater than the legally required 45 percent.
